references.text: The first offering from Nahshon includes the same silver plate, silver bowl, and weight as here, establishing the pattern for all the tribes' offerings
Eliab's offering from the tribe of Zebulun has identical items and measurements as described here
Elisur's offering from the tribe of Reuben follows the same pattern with a silver plate and silver bowl
Selumiel's offering from the tribe of Simeon contains the same elements
Eliasaph's offering from the tribe of Gad has the same contents and weight
Description of the plates and bowls to be made for the tabernacle
The sanctuary shekel is mentioned as the standard unit of weight, the same one used here
The grain offering of fine flour mixed with oil, which fills the vessels in this verse
